newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Telecom says associates improve.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Telecom says associates improve.

text.p: Singapore Telecom (SingTel) said on Friday its IDD traffic grew by 12.9 percent during its first half period ended September 30 1996.

The performace of associated and joint venture companies improved significantly as the new investments in Belgacom and PT Bukaka SingTel International started to contribute to results of the group, it said.
In line with rationalisation of its investments, the group has reduced its interest in certain joint venture companies at a profit, SingTel said.
SingTel annnounced on Friday that its first half net profit rose 13.6 percent to Singapore $843.5 million on a turnover of S$2.17 billion.
